title: Design-round mockups never reach the Mockups tab: .active is not surfaced by /api/editor-design-state
description:
A design round created with `codeyam-editor editor design-round --new` is invisible to the editor UI, so the Mockups tab stays empty for the entire round and the agent has to build a parallel viewing surface by hand.

What happens: `design-round --new` allocates `.codeyam/design/rounds/<id>/`, writes `round.json`, and writes the round id into `.codeyam/design/rounds/.active`. `design-round --current` reads that file back correctly. The round-scoped HTTP API is fully functional — with round-1 active and six mockups on disk, `GET /api/editor-mockups?round=round-1` returns all six, `GET /api/editor-mockups-target?round=round-1` returns {"count":6}, `GET /api/editor-mockups/<file>?round=round-1` serves the exact bytes, and the lint findings come back per-card as expected.

The break is the handoff to the UI. The Mockups panel resolves its round from `GET /api/editor-design-state` and then builds every request through a helper equivalent to `In(url, round)`, which appends `?round=<id>` only when the round is truthy. `/api/editor-design-state` returns {"active":null} even though `.codeyam/design/rounds/.active` contains `round-1`, so the panel fetches the UNSCOPED `/api/editor-mockups`, which is the questionnaire's project-wide `.codeyam/design/project_mockups/` directory. That directory is empty in round mode by design (round mode is explicitly documented as never touching it), so the panel renders zero cards with no error — a silent empty state that reads as "the agent produced nothing".

There is no agent-side workaround: `POST /api/editor-design-state` returns 405, and the endpoint appears not to read the `.active` file at all rather than caching it (the round was created well after server start, but a restart was not attempted, so a stale-cache variant is not fully ruled out).

Suggested fix: have `/api/editor-design-state` resolve `active` from `.codeyam/design/rounds/.active` (the same source `design-round --current` already reads), so the existing round-scoped plumbing lights up end to end. The whole rest of round mode already works; this is one endpoint away from the built-in compare grid, per-card feedback and iterate flow working for rounds exactly as they do for the questionnaire.

Observed on the puzzle-school-rebuild branch while running a layout design round against the Home surface; worked around by publishing gitignored copies under public/ and driving the Live Preview with preview-nav.
